reviews.title: The crew politeness/ service made up for the plane inadequcies
reviews.text: I often take Asian airlines like (MAS, SIA, Thai) and I will compare XiamenAir against them. What I like 1. The crew uniform is kinda neat and smart. The blue color looks good on them. 2. The food. Among all the airlines, I always enjoy XIamen Airline‘s local xiamen food. For this flight, they served pork minced rice with other things, which I really enjoyed. The taste was good. 3. Polite and efficient crew. Despite the full flight with chinese passengers, the efficient and polite to all incessant request for pillows, blanket and drinks. 4. The fight announcement was made in english, mandarin and the local fujianese (min an) dialect. I am a fujianese, so hearing the announcent in my mother tongue gives me very good vibes. What I din like 1. No inseat charging port. For a 4hr flight, I would expect a charging port to be available 2. No inseat entertaiment, only an overhead unit which shows a boring movie. I would expect Xiamen Airline to provide inflight wifi streaming to personal devices capability. The overhead unit is so ancient. 3. No wifi to be purchased. Overall, the food matters to me more, so I wld rate。this flight Xiamen Air as 7/10.
reviews.author: AhWah

reviews.title: Will gladly take your money, cancel flight, and then good luck getting a refund
reviews.text: Booked a flight from CGO to HKG through Expedia (the only option). A couple days prior to the flight Xiamen Airlines canceled it and provided no reasonable alternative, forcing us to travel by train instead. Since then, it has been impossible to get a refund. Xiamen Air does not reply to any queries from Expedia.
reviews.author: johnWorldwide

reviews.title: Xiamen Airlines refused me(person in wheelchair), without explanation
reviews.text: i was sepose to fly 17 April 2023 00.40 with Xiamen Airlines to Amsterdam. I was at the check-in desk 16 April 20.00 . in my wheelchair. they told me I can t check in. why I asked? no reaction. I got no respons. my pasport was not expired, I got my PCR test. all y papers in order. they just refused me. and left me at the airport all alone. no help to get me on another flyte, no hotel , no drink ore food coupon. nothing. they left me, a person in wheelchair, with 3 suites case all alone on the airport. all alone. finally I found a person who drove me to taxies, and I drove the rest of the night to find a hotel that would take me in . I booked a new flight, other airline ofcourse 1,5 x the price. . but now I don t get my money back, all the cost I had , the emotional damage , the cost you have a person in a wheelchair... nothing. this is just criminal.
reviews.author: me y

reviews.title: Uncomfortable Planes, Bad Food, Terrible Transfer at Xiamen Airport
reviews.text: First, they put us on a tiny 737 for the six-hour flight from Bali to Xiamen. No in-flight entertainment, not even so much as a pair of headphones, and nowhere to charge your phone, which is a challenge because you require your phone to do the online customs declaration. Then, in six hours, all they served us was a piece of sweet bread, a tiny bag of chips, and 100mL of sweet yoghurt drink. This is the least space I've ever had on a plane. There was so little room, it was difficult even to put a bag on the floor. There were only 30cm between my seat and the one in front of me. Very uncomfortable and no room to move at all. Then, we get to Xiamen airport and find out our connecting flight is leaving two hours later than scheduled, so a three-hour layover became a five-hour one. Transferring at Xiamen airport is a hot mess. You need to go through immigration, exit the secure area, check in again from the outside, and go through security a second time, even if you're not even stopping in China. At immigration, they stopped most of the foreigners and questioned them intensely before letting them through. My husband was questioned for over an hour before we could go on to our connecting flight. He's lived in China for 12 years; they already have all of his information on file, but they questioned him anyway, sometimes asking the same question three or four times. Not sure if it was incompetence, lack of training, some new system, or a mandate to heighten security, but either way,
reviews.author: Dee L

reviews.title: Excellent Customers
reviews.text: While flying from Vancouver to Vietnam I had a 10 hour layover in Xiamen airport in China before a connecting trip to Vietnam. When I was going to board my connecting flight to Vietnam I realized I had not purchased a travel visa. I was in a panic situation because I only had 24 hours before I could leave China Legally and I couldn't board my flight. The firewalls made it difficult to have a consistent internet connection and purchase a visa ticket on my phone. Fortunately Xiamen was able to reschedule my flight the next evening free of charge and also booked me a hotel in the city to spend the night so I didn't have to sleep in the airport!!! I was able to process a visa within the right time frame that would allow me into Vietnam and avoid any further problems. Thank Xiamen Airlines for your professional and reliable service!
reviews.author: Sean

reviews.title: I am satisfied with everything except the food on board
reviews.text: 個人的には、中国系航空会社の中では最も良い印象を受けた。チェックイン時及び、搭乗時対応、更には、機内の清掃も行き届いており、CAの対応も良い印象、なので自然と乗客のマナーも良くなる感じを受けた。ただ、惜しむらくは、機内食ですね これならば、寧ろ無くすか、或いは有料化して充実度を向上させる位割り切れば、もっと良いかなと思った。
reviews.author: 365GT4-BB

reviews.title: Flyers Beware!
reviews.text: This has been, by far, the worst airline that I have ever had the misfortune to encounter. They have shown such poor customer service that I was compelled to review them on multiple platforms to warn other potential customers of their airline. I showed up at Xiamen Airport (Xiamen Airlines flagship hub) 5 hours in advance of my flight for two reasons. First, I knew that my bags would be overweight (I was moving back home to the states), and I wanted to see by how much. I had some items I could discard to make the baggage lighter, but I wanted to see how much over I was. Second, since COVID still had regulations, I wanted to be sure that I had enough time to get through the process on time. Xiamen Airlines, unfortunately, did not make any of this process possible. When I arrived at the airport, I was informed that I would not be able to set foot into the international wing until two hours before the flight took off. This forced me to wait patiently at a fast-food restaurant until they opened the wing. Once the wing was open, the sold-out flight loaded up the kiosks. The line was moving unbelievably slow, but I knew that the attendants were able to see me waiting (I am the only Black person on the flight, and I am also 6’4”, which will be important for later) and that I probably will need extra help. This entire process of getting through the line nearly took an hour and a half. Once I got to the front of the line, the first thing that they informed me of was that there were on
reviews.author: Jason Q

reviews.title: Extremely old airplane and limited service
reviews.text: Plane is around 38 years old. Old uncomfortable seats. Adjusting only 1,2 cm backwards. See last photo for maximum adjustment. Food only one dish available from a range of 4 main dishes. Drinks only water. Bit too less choice for business class. Positive: Boarding starts on time. Security concept of Pudong airport for Covid19. Negative: Flight departures with a delay and without any information. To sit on those polyester chairs longer than needed is indeed painful. No video entertainment. Check in from Xiamen Air was badly organized. Only one 1 account for business class. Waiting time 22 minutes. Lounge in the new Pudong terminal is ok. Summary: Not happy but healthy l. There are other Chinese Airlines which are not perfect but much better organized. Xiamen Air is on the same level as horrible spring airlines company.
reviews.author: Peter S

reviews.title: Great inflight service
reviews.text: Somehow check in was accomplished without me saying a word. Just hand over the passport and you get a boarding card. The plane boarded early and left bang on time ( somewhat of a miracle in China) The food was especially wierd, a bit like a savoury chicken jelly served alongside a sweet bread roll stuffed with egg yolk. Unusually for Chinese airlines, beer was available. The in flight movie was switched off before the end (40 mins from landing) but otherwise the flight was fine. So so so much better than China Eastern.
reviews.author: MattwalesNorthWales

reviews.title: XiaMen Airline sells fraud flight tickets and refused to refund the passenger! Shocking!!!
reviews.text: XiaMen Airline sells fraud flight tickets and refused to refund the passenger! Shocking!!! Chinese Embassy in the Netherlands announced that no transfer passengers would be allowed to enter the Netherlands for the connecting flight to China from 18th November. XiaMen Airline is aware of this new policy. However, they continue advertising and selling the connecting flight tickets through the Netherlands! I bought the ticket from London to China via the transfer in Amsterdam. However, when I started to go through the travel detailed soon after I bought the ticket, I was shocked to find out that this is an impossible flight route due to the reason above. I contacted XiaMen Airline immediately. I received a reply call informing me that my request for refunding my flight ticket is rejected. The reason given was that XiaMen Airline made a policy, they only refund the flight tickets which were bought before 31st October 2020, and the flight will take off after 31st October 2020. My flight ticket was bought yesterday, 9th December 2020. Therefore, I fell out of the category of refunding. I pointed out that if they knew this is the policy, why they were still selling the tickets from London to China, which needs to transfer at Amsterdam. I was told that it was because some passengers will take the flights from Amsterdam. This was not answering to my question. However, the customer service only gave me “standard answers” in a circle. I would like to get your advice, what should I do no

reviews.title: Understanding and quick online responses
reviews.text: We bought our low-price tickets online in Oct 2019 and were supposed to fly today, 21 May 2020. In middle Feb we contacted the airline to seek for options as we didn’t want to travel during the pandemic. Email correspondences was effective and replied within reasonable timeframe considering the start of the outbreak. By end of Feb, we received our full refund which we are very grateful for. We wish the airline and its people well and hope they will stay progressive and resilient.
reviews.author: bubblysunflower

reviews.title: Friendly staff, plane is clean. Definitely will travel again.
reviews.text: Xiamen airport is not huge. This is first time we flew via Xiamen airline form China to Sydney. 787 good legroom, not crowded, could be because of the virus season and country entry restriction. The staffs are friendly. The breakfast is quite simple. Again could be because of the special period. Will definitely travel this airline again!
reviews.author: Steph D

reviews.title: Flight was cancelled due to Corona virus, but they did not let us down.
reviews.text: When Xiamen Airlines had to cancel out flight home to Vancouver, because of the Corona 19 virus, they advised us how to go about to get a refund for the unsused portion of the flight. They were very helpful when we phoned them after the cancellation. We received a refund two days agao. Thank you.

reviews.title: dishonest company ,canceled the flight on their own and not refund my money
reviews.text: This company has very bad management and very poor services, they canceled my flight, claiming due to the virus situation within very short notice two days before the departure and they do not refund me the ticket . actually their customer service is so poor that they do not even acknowledge the fact. I would never ever use such company again. stay away with this airline also priceline has poor customer service too.
reviews.author: Guy

reviews.title: My Least Enjoyable Plane Ride So Far
reviews.text: The aircraft doesn't have air-conditioning system and it's too hot that I was sweating inside the entire flight. Coming from a - 2°C temperature in Beijing, I was wearing layers of clothes and I had to take them off as I feel like I'm more of sitting in a sauna than in an airplane. The food is bland and not too inviting to eat but it's somehow ok since it's just a short flight anyway. The FAs are accommodating somehow doing their best to break the language barrier so they can provide the service that I deserve as their passenger. This is my 23rd flight so far, and this is the least enjoyable and comfortable that I ever had.
reviews.author: Wanderlad

reviews.title: Cancellation without any notice
reviews.text: Outbound trip is okay, inbound trip was canceled, but nobody from Xiamen airline gave me any notice. Found my trip was canceled, call Xiamen airline service rep, they want to charge me tickets change fee even because Xiamen airline canceled my reservation.

reviews.title: Good service
reviews.text: I got good experience about refund. The costumer service take a little time but I am sure they are doing their best. If you have no answer from phone or email. Try to send a message on Facebook they are very active. Very good company for a cheap price
reviews.author: Nzo C

reviews.title: Spend the extra money, go on a different airline
reviews.text: I am extremely disappointed in the customer service I received from this airline. I paid $748.00 to change the flight for me and my partner, because I was given the wrong date to return on. $400 of that fee was just for them to make the change. Shortly after making this payment they involuntarily changed the flight I had just paid to change. I was able to call and cancel my flights but they refused to give me the $400 back for the cost the to make the change, which they immediately changed which take away the point of paying $400 of a specific flight home that matches our schedule.
reviews.author: Allie M

reviews.text: Nice flight, nothing to rave about but no complaints. Compares with Chongqing Airlines get the cheapest option.

I am Indonesian passport holder, but currently living in Singapore and will travel to Seoul for vacation. As always I do my research before the trip, and carefully pick the best yet affordable flight ticket. I picked SQ as my first flight going to Seoul. And then for my return, I was considering about xiamen airlines. Its cheap, but said we do have to transit in xiamen. Then after some times, okay our decision went for xiamen airlines. Later after we booked the flight, I checked that xiamen Airport didn't have a waiting area for transit and International passengers. So we have to proceed the immigration when transit. I was started to panic and did another deeply research about a visa. Did I need a visa just for less than 2 hours transit in xiamen? I asked the Chinese embassy, and they said, they didn't know, said to ask the airline. Then I ask the xiamen airlines, and they provided me the same answer as the embassy. Feeling desperately helpless and our duedate is getting closer, I found a websites that says China has 72 and 24hours free visa for transit tourist. Well it has been categorised based on depends countries, and Indonesia was included on the list for 24 hours free visa exemption. Also I found a blog saying the same experience as me, which is Indonesian travelled with xiamen and have a tran

reviews.title: Good trip
reviews.text: Intercontinental flights are never fun or comfortable but I was happy to see that this flight was better than average.

reviews.title: Great value for money
reviews.text: Great service on board, food was also very tasty. In-flight entertainment was good, with many options available. check-in needed to be redone in xiamen but it worked fine. the hotels provided by xiamen for the long layovers in china were basic but decent
reviews.author: Radumarinxyz

reviews.title: You get what you pay for
reviews.text: Being on the cheaper end of airlines, it was better than expected. Huge plane, smooth flight, friendly staff, but terrible food. On the way there the TVs didn't work but on the way back they worked just fine. You cannot check in & get your boarding pass online - you can only do this at the airline counter, which is really annoying & time-consuming. The airline was totally fine, just bring your own food/snacks & make sure you have books/movies downloaded in advance
reviews.author: elbsb813

reviews.title: Worse than Ethiopian airlines
reviews.text: The worst airlines ever. And I travelled a lot (almost 50 countries now). They cheat and lie to the customers and can cancel your flight one day in advance without any reason. They will not give you any compensation and you have to fight for rebooking and hotel. You have to bear the costs. They will tell you that they will call you, but they won't. When you arrive to the airport they will be one of few airlines not present. Literally, the worst airlines at least in china. If everything is OK, there is no problem. But when there is a problem you are in a deep sh*it
reviews.author: Paweł K

reviews.title: Only fly with them if ticket fare matter the most
reviews.text: Not recommended if you are looking for good service and space. The seat is smaller then other full service airlines and very uncomfotable, food was terrible, stewardess speak limited english. Fly with them only if you are going to Xiamen or if you have limited budget but want a full service airline.
reviews.author: Martin

reviews.title: Vacation Finally Starts!
reviews.text: First time using this airline and I was immediately impressed to see a water bottle and socks waiting for me when I got to my seat for my late night flight. Food was fine if you like Chinese cuisine. I didn't recognize some of the food, but I loved the hot dishes with the perfectly made rice. Very filling.
